source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    To check BMC port LED is normal.
1. Plug network cable on shared and chcek the link status

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.

deepseek_columns.ai_packages_needed: physical sight of the BMC port LED (operator)
deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- BMC Port LED Checking: visually confirm the BMC port LED lights as SPEC (color/state). A physical LED inspection; the agent cannot see the chassis LEDs.

original_test_intent: Verify that the BMC port's physical LED presents the exact platform-specified colour and steady/blink state after the approved cable is connected to the shared port.
original_method: An engineer identifies the BMC/shared connector, connects the approved cable and peer, visually observes and photographs the LED, and compares its state with the board/port specification.
manual_activity: The core result is the visible LED state after physical cable insertion. An engineer must make the connection, observe colour/steady/blink behaviour and capture the evidence.
required_inputs: Board revision and exact BMC/shared connector identity
Authoritative LED state table including timing and link/activity meaning
Approved cable, peer/switch port and final cable state
Maintenance approval, physical operator and OOB recovery
safety_requirements: Do not cable a guessed port or unapproved network peer.
Assess shared host/BMC traffic before inserting or removing the cable.
Do not manipulate power or repeatedly reconnect merely to force an LED state.
Stop on ambiguous identity, host/BMC disruption or abnormal connector/LED behaviour; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Capture mapped host/BMC link, counters and health before and after the observation.
Prepare the photo/timing checklist and correlate operator evidence with switch/BMC telemetry.
Report link results without claiming direct visual observation.
engineer_actions: Approve the port, peer and LED acceptance specification.
Connect the cable and visually record LED state at the required time.
Compare the state with the specification and issue PASS/FAIL.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly states that no command can prove the visible LED. Any network telemetry is supporting correlation only.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use documented read-only BMC/host/switch link and counter data only to timestamp and corroborate the visual observation.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Shared cable insertion, LED-as-spec criterion and 5/0-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.status: RETAIN VISUAL INSPECTION WITH LINK CORRELATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Identify the shared BMC port from platform documentation, connect the approved peer, capture a timestamped LED photo/video covering the specified interval and correlate it with mapped link/activity telemetry.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact BMC/shared port, LED implementation and approved network peer.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record board/BMC/NIC firmware and peer configuration.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform port/LED specification and NC-SI/network topology.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds stable port identity, timing and telemetry correlation without replacing visual acceptance.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; telemetry does not claim colour or blink-state coverage.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: LED table, port map and peer.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Camera exposure or refresh rate can misrepresent blink patterns; engineer observation remains authoritative.

project_override_considerations: A project may define the peer, observation interval and LED mapping. Missing values make execution not ready, not permanently blocked. Link-up alone is not an equivalent override for the visual criterion.
expected_evidence: Board/port and LED specification plus cable/peer identity
Timestamped photo/video or operator observation of colour and pattern
Correlated host/BMC/switch link and counter state
Restored final cabling, health/error review and separate engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently requires a shared-port cable action and physical LED comparison against specification.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The visual method is clear. Port and LED specifics are readiness inputs rather than permanent blockers.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Agree with NO but add topology, timing and shared-network safety requirements.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agree with MANUAL ONLY and retain its port/peer/specification controls.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates visual evidence from electronic link correlation and formal verdict.

review_improvement: Makes colour, pattern and timing explicit so generic link-up or a photo of the wrong shared connector cannot satisfy the test.
independent_technical_reasoning: Electronic status cannot establish the emitted colour or temporal LED pattern. Because that visual signal is the sole criterion and cabling is physical, the case is MANUAL ONLY.
